form.label: HashiCorp Vault Audit - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed HashiCorp Vault audit JSON relay overview. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ vault_audit_family="auth" | stats count
index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ (vault_audit_family="secret" OR vault_audit_family="policy" OR match(signature, "^(secret|kv|sys)/")) | stats count
index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ (status="failure" OR error=* OR error_detail=*) | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by Vault audit family

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(vault_audit_family, vault_type, type, "vault_audit") | timechart count by family
index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(vault_audit_family, vault_type, type, "vault_audit") | stats count by family | sort -count

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval vault_operation=coalesce(action, 'request.operation'), vault_result=coalesce(status, result, vault_type, type) | stats count by vault_operation vault_result | sort -count | head 30

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval vault_actor=coalesce(user, src_user, 'auth.display_name', 'auth.metadata.username', 'auth.entity_id') | stats count by vault_actor | sort -count | head 20

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip, src, 'request.remote_address'), source_port=coalesce(src_port, 'request.remote_port') | stats count by source_ip source_port | sort -count | head 30

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval vault_path=coalesce(object, signature, 'request.path', 'request.request_uri') | stats count dc(request_id) as request_ids values(action) as operations values(vault_audit_family) as families values(vault_namespace) as namespaces values(vault_mount_type) as mount_types by vault_path | sort -count | head 50

panel.title: Token lifecycle TTL and renewability context

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ vault_audit_family="token_lifecycle" | table _time host user src_ip action signature vault_token_lifecycle vault_token_type vault_token_ttl vault_token_renewable vault_token_policies vault_token_orphan request_id status result marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ (vault_audit_family="secret" OR vault_audit_family="policy") | table _time host vault_audit_family vault_namespace vault_mount_type vault_mount_accessor user src_ip action object signature vault_policy_allowed vault_policy_override request_id status result marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ (vault_audit_family="audit_device" OR match(signature, "^sys/audit")) | table _time host user src_ip action signature vault_audit_device request_id status result marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | eval namespace=coalesce(vault_namespace, 'request.namespace.path', "root"), mount_type=coalesce(vault_mount_type, 'request.mount_type'), mount_accessor=coalesce(vault_mount_accessor, 'request.mount_accessor') | stats count values(action) as operations values(object) as paths values(user) as actors by namespace mount_type mount_accessor | sort -count | head 50

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | stats count values(vault_type) as types values(vault_audit_family) as families values(action) as operations values(object) as paths values(user) as actors values(src_ip) as source_ips values(vault_namespace) as namespaces values(vault_mount_type) as mount_types values(status) as statuses min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by request_id | where isnotnull(request_id) | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -last_seen | head 50

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ (vault_audit_family="policy_denied" OR vault_policy_allowed="false" OR vault_policy_override="true") | table _time host user src_ip action object vault_policy_allowed vault_policy_override vault_client_id vault_request_uri vault_wrap_ttl error_detail request_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host vault_audit_family vault_type vault_namespace | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=netauth sourcetype="hashicorp:vault:audit" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host vault_audit_family vault_type vault_namespace vault_namespace_id vault_mount_type vault_mount_accessor vault_audit_device vault_token_lifecycle vault_token_type vault_token_ttl vault_token_renewable vault_token_policies vault_token_orphan vault_policy_allowed vault_policy_override vault_client_id vault_request_uri vault_wrap_ttl user src_user src_ip src src_port action signature signature_id request_id status result error_detail object marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
